messages:
alex: heads up — customer-jane reporting a surge of 502/504s to hosted api (embeddings) during a high concurrency batch. started ~09:10 UTC, affecting one region. opening a thread :rotating_light:
customer-jane: repro steps: POST /v1/embeddings with 100 concurrent connections, tenant header X-Tenant: acme. about 15-30% of requests return HTTP/2 502 or connection reset after ~800ms. curl example i used at the customer side below.
alex: ```
curl -v --http2 \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Tenant: acme" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input": "..."}' \n  https://api.hosted.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```
maria: do we have envoy logs / trace ids for the failed requests? any config or deploy around 08:55-09:05?
alex: deploy-bot shows an envoy config push at 08:58 that adjusted cluster max_connections and per-host keepalive. envoy logs show repeated lines like: ```
[2026-03-17T09:11:59.123Z] upstream reset: connection failure, TLS handshake timed out, source=frontdoor-proxy-1
[2026-03-17T09:12:00.456Z] filter_chain_match: sni="ingest.acme.corp.internal" handshake_duration_ms=520
[2026-03-17T09:12:01.789Z] connection: remote closed during h2 preface
```
liam: interesting — customer mentioned custom SNI: "ingest.acme.corp.internal" (long). long SNI + large cert chain can increase handshake CPU/latency. also we changed connection pool parameters in that push. could be head-of-line at accept/TLS stage.
nada: checking metrics — frontdoor accept queue depth spiked to 256 and h2 open-streams for new pods shot up. TLS handshake p50 jumped from 40ms -> 380ms during the spike.
maria: can customer reproduce with a single machine using http2 + repeated new connections? if yes we can simulate with curl --http2 and --resolve to force SNI routing.
alex: customer supplied a minimal repro: ```
for i in {1..200}; do \n  curl -sS --http2 --resolve "api.hosted.redwood.example:443:34.210.10.5" \n    -H "Host: api.hosted.redwood.example" \n    -H "X-Tenant: acme" \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n    -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.hosted.redwood.example/v1/embeddings &
 done; wait
```
ops-bot: suggested mitigation: bump proxy accept backlog and worker threads, revert the latest cluster keepalive change if needed, and add an immediate circuit-breaker on handshake-timeout > 250ms. ops will attempt a config patch.
deploy-bot: rolling a targeted restart of frontdoor-proxy nodes in the affected AZ now (config patch: increase `listener_socket_options.backlog` and revert `cluster.max_connections` delta).
alex: patch applied and pods restarted at 09:18 UTC in az-a. early telemetry: error rate dropped from 22% -> 3% in that AZ. customer-jane confirming fewer failures.
customer-jane: after restart we're seeing far fewer 502s, thanks. still occasional failures (~<1%).
liam: follow-ups: add SNI length histogram to ingress telemetry, add handshake-duration alert, and revert any unnecessary keepalive reductions. I'll file a ticket and own it.
nada: filed INF-6243: "Ingress: handshake-duration / SNI-length telemetry + circuit-breaker for TLS handshake" and assigned to @liam.
maria: thanks team — closing the immediate escalation. if the error rate goes >0.5% again we'll open a postmortem. :thumbsup:
